# searchconsole

10 curated tools, plus 1 generated tool (Google Discovery parameter names; see `searchconsole_discover`).

## `searchconsole_searchanalytics_query`

Class: read

Query Google Search Console search analytics data. Returns clicks, impressions, CTR, and position for your site. Supports filtering by query, page, country, device, search type, and date range.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `siteUrl` | string | required | Site URL (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com") |
| `startDate` | string | required | Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Data is available starting ~3 days ago. |
| `endDate` | string | required | End date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `dimensions` | array | optional | Dimensions to group by. Common: ["query", "page"], ["date"], ["query", "date"] |
| `type` | enum | optional | Search type filter (default: web) |
| `dimensionFilterGroups` | array | optional | Filters to narrow results. Example: filter by page containing "/blog/" or query containing "keyword" |
| `rowLimit` | number | optional | Max rows to return (default: 1000, max: 25000) |
| `startRow` | number | optional | Zero-based row offset for pagination (default: 0) |
| `aggregationType` | enum | optional | How to aggregate data (default: auto) |
| `dataState` | enum | optional | "all" includes fresh (not finalized) data; "final" only finalized data |

## `searchconsole_url_inspect`

Class: read

Inspect a URL using the Google Search Console URL Inspection API. Returns indexing status, crawl info, rich results, AMP status, and mobile usability for a specific URL. Pass `inspectionUrls` instead to inspect up to 20 URLs of the same property in one call (one result per URL; a failing URL does not stop the others).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `siteUrl` | string | required | Site URL as registered in Search Console (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com") |
| `inspectionUrl` | string | optional | The fully-qualified URL to inspect (must be under the siteUrl property). Pass this or inspectionUrls. |
| `inspectionUrls` | array | optional | Several fully-qualified URLs to inspect, all under the siteUrl property, up to 20. Pass this or inspectionUrl. |
| `languageCode` | string | optional | BCP-47 language code for localized results (e.g. "en-US", "fr") |
